2893-3470-4500-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2946-3025-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-3025-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3025-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

728-3249-5687-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5687-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-2866-4211-4986.description:

Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1669-3478-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.

Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Repeat.

3641-4399-4770-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3641-4399-4770-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1580-2292-4556-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.

Blink Wormfang Manta using Soulherder. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

141-997-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.

Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.

Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.

Repeat from step 2.

560-4550-4616-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-4616-6797.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Moldervine Reclamation triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and draw two cards.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Repeat.

2043-4094-5231-5446.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.

Activate Thermopod six times by sacrificing six Cats, adding six {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-3257-5671.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, The Necrobloom, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and The Necrobloom trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.

3525-3821-5921-5970-6120.description:

Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Bottomless Pool.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Synth Infiltrator.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Synth Infiltrator and another permanent you control.
Activate Synth Infiltrator by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.

When each land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Second Sunrise on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

3134-4050-4840-4853.notablePrerequisites: Cryptek does not have summoning sickness.

Activate Cryptek by paying {1}{B} and tapping it, targeting Myr Battlesphere.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {B}.
Myr Battlesphere dies, triggering Cryptek and Dross Scorpion.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cryptek.
Resolve the Cryptek trigger, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Myr, adding {1}.
Repeat.

During your combat phase, activate the nontoken Aurelia by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Declare the token Aurelia as an attacker.

Repeat each combat phase.

618-2104-3277.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch with haste.
The token copy of Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

618-4091.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a token copy of Aphetto Alchemist with haste.
Tap the Aphetto Alchemist token to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat for infinite ETB and tapped creature tokens with haste.

1053-2292-2836-2890-4400-4583-4892-5161.notablePrerequisites: There are no basic lands in library.
1053-2292-2836-2890-4400-4583-4892-5161.description:
Cast Flash, putting Protean Hulk on the battlefield, choosing not to pay and sacrificng Protean Hulk.
Protean Hulk's LTB triggers, searching your library for Body Snatcher, Viscera Seer and Torch Courier and putting them onto the battlefield.
In response to Body Snatcher's ETB trigger, activate Viscera Seer sacrificing Body Double.
Body Snatcher's LTB triggers, exiling Body Snatcher and returning Protean Hulk to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Resolve the Body Snatcher ETB, failing to discard a card.
Activate Viscera Seer, sacrificing Protean Hulk, searching your library for Laboratory Maniac, Hermit Druid and Hapless Researcher, then putting them onto the battlefield.
Activate Torch Courier, sacrificing itself and giving Hermit Druid haste.
Activate Hermit Druid, milling your library.
Activate Hapless Researcher, winning the game.
